description: This file defines an interface for shopping cart calculation services, specifying methods to calculate total summaries for shopping carts within an e-commerce system.

classes.name: ShoppingCartCalculationService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for calculating shopping cart total summaries, considering optional customer and store context.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates total and sub-total for a shopping cart, optionally considering the customer context, returning an OrderTotalSummary.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates total and sub-total for a shopping cart in the context of a store and language, returning an OrderTotalSummary.
